articles.title: US-Iran conflict adds fresh strain to Pakistan's fragile economy
articles.titleEn: US-Iran conflict adds fresh strain to Pakistan's fragile economy
articles.summary: Pakistan faces a growing inflation crisis. Tensions between the United States and Iran are driving up fuel prices. This is making daily life difficult for ordinary citizens. Salaried workers and low-income families struggle to afford basic necessities. Petrol prices have surged significantly. Diesel prices have also increased. This impacts transportation and food costs.
